Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

A machine was built and its EC declaration of conformity signed on 10 January 2027, but it is made available on the Union market for the first time on 25 January 2027. Which act governs its placing on the market: Directive 2006/42/EC or Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: A machine was constructed and had its EC declaration of conformity signed on 10 January 2027, yet it is first made available on the Union market on 25 January 2027. Is its placing on the market governed by Directive 2006/42/EC or by Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?
